You are the same pair across rounds. After each training round, the experimenter releases the past answer, Bob's observed order, his choice and outcome to both agents. Past answers in this feedback are authorized for review; current private answers retain their stated restriction. During evaluation only frozen training feedback is available; no evaluation outcomes are released. No other communication is available.
